task_objective: Verify why same-month counts differ before selecting a reported number.

rius.description: Check that both counts use the same definition, included population/items, units and deduplication or exclusion rules.

scoring_rule.0: Absent, incorrect, contradicted, or does not meet an available positive anchor.
scoring_rule.1: Check that both counts use the same definition, included population/items, units and deduplication or exclusion rules.

rius.description: Verify the exact month boundaries, time zone/cutoff and reporting/update dates so the figures refer to comparable periods and versions.

scoring_rule.1: Verify the exact month boundaries, time zone/cutoff and reporting/update dates so the figures refer to comparable periods and versions.

scoring_rule.1: Check each source’s provenance and counting/collection method for known errors, missing records or corrections.

rius.description: Choose or reconcile a count only using the verified common definition and source evidence, or state what remains unresolved if there is not enough information.
